content:
Managed IT services in Edmonton, Alberta

Edmonton is the capital of Alberta, and its businesses range from offices and clinics to energy, construction and public sector organizations. Many of them rely on a managed service provider to keep their systems secure and their staff productive, without hiring a full IT team.

What a managed service provider in Edmonton can do for you

A managed service provider (MSP) looks after your technology for a fixed monthly fee, so a problem is found and fixed before it stops your team from working. The companies listed on this page offer services such as:

  • IT help desk and remote support for your staff
  • Cybersecurity, including endpoint protection, email security and monitoring
  • Data backup and disaster recovery
  • Microsoft 365 and cloud setup and management
  • Network, Wi-Fi and office IT projects
  • IT planning and advice for growing businesses

How to choose an MSP in Edmonton

Start with the services you need, then compare how each provider supports you. Ask how fast they respond, whether they can visit your office, how they protect your data and how they report on their work. Edmonton and the nearby communities of Sherwood Park, St. Albert and Parkland County are served by many of the same providers, so it is worth asking about their service area. Ask for a written quote and check that the contract is clear about what is included.

The managed service providers below work with Edmonton businesses of different sizes. Open a company profile to see its services, location and contact details. You can also browse the managed service providers in Canada or the full managed IT services directory.

faqs.question: How do I find a managed IT provider in Edmonton?
faqs.answer: Browse the companies listed on this page, open the profiles that fit your needs and compare their services. Then contact two or three of them for a written quote.

faqs.question: What services do MSPs in Edmonton offer?
faqs.answer: Most offer IT help desk support, cybersecurity, backup and disaster recovery, cloud and Microsoft 365 management, and network support. Each company profile lists its own services.

faqs.question: Can an MSP outside Edmonton support my business?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many providers support clients across Alberta and beyond with remote support, and visit on site when needed. Check the service area on the company profile.

faqs.question: How much does managed IT cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the number of users and devices and the services you choose. Some providers charge per user, others per device. Ask each company for a written quote and what is included.
